rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=4, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=18, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-15 NFE (fewer steps) lever, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: steps16 (iter-14) DROPPED to hr0 (RMSE5.82e-3) vs steps8 hr0.0768 -- more Euler steps HURT (each step re-embeds noise + evaluates the near-off prior -> accumulated drift). (2) FAILURE MODE: extra steps compound the deterministic re-embed noise injection and prior drift. Direction: fewer steps. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_steps 8 -> 4 (halve the Euler/DC re-embed count), n_cg18/init_t0.005 fixed. (4) HYPOTHESIS: fewer steps = less accumulated re-embed drift while the strong CG-DC (n_cg18) still pins the data -> RMSE <= steps8 (hr>=0.0768). If flat/slightly worse, steps=8 is optimal. FALSIFIER: if hr drops, too few DC applications under-constrain -> 8 is the sweet spot. (5) BUDGET ~1.5min. (6) iter-16 on landing.
